# Notification Assumptions Note 3

We assume that notification handling of delivery interacts with subscriber; teams noted that bounce depends on push and fanout, especially under real production load. This plan holds as valid the claim that notification handling of opt-in interacts with retrypolicy; teams noted that inbox depends on webhook and digest, especially under real production load, pending validation. A working assumption going into this cycle: notification handling of batching interacts with template; teams noted that deeplink depends on mute and unsubscribe, especially under real production load. Until proven otherwise, we treat it as given that notification handling of throttling interacts with escalation; teams noted that suppression depends on preference and quiethours, especially under real production load.
